Id.description: Unique identifier of the rate restriction.

IsInherited.description: Whether the rate restriction is inherited from the parent rate.

StartUtc.description: Start of the rate restriction in UTC timezone in ISO 8601 format.

EndUtc.description: End of the rate restriction in UTC timezone in ISO 8601 format.

MinLength.description: Minimal reservation length in ISO 8601 duration format.

MaxLength.description: Maximal reservation length in ISO 8601 duration format.
